title: Most Frequent K Values
prompt:
Given a list of integers nums and an integer k, return the k values that occur most often in nums. The answer is guaranteed to be unique (there are no ties at the k-th position). The returned values may be in any order.

Try to do better than sorting all distinct values when k is small, for example with a heap.

Example:
  top_k_frequent([5, 5, 5, 2, 2, 9], 2) -> [5, 2]   (any order)
